answer_1.quote: We selected three widely recognized generation tasks with RAG settings for response generation: Question Answering, Data-to-text Writing, and News Summarization.
answer_1.outputs: answers to QA prompts, business overview texts, news article summaries

answer_3.quote: Hallucination Detection Prompt: Hallucination detection prompts are manually crafted to instruct LLMs (GPT-4-turbo and GPT-3.5-turbo) in assessing whether a given reference-response pair contains hallucinated content and to identify the corresponding hallucinated spans in the response.

answer_4.quote: We recruited annotators ... Their task was to annotate the specific spans of the generated text that contains hallucinated information and categorize them into the four types.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to label hallucinated spans and assign each to one of the four hallucination categories (Evident Conflict, Subtle Conflict, Evident Baseless, Subtle Baseless).
